details:
- Rebase onto Red Hat rsync-3.1.3-28 (RHSA-2026:74095)
- CVE-2026-53795: arbitrary file write through --temp-dir or --link-dest,
  now also refused for a local or remote-shell receiver
- CVE-2026-53800: --remove-source-files could delete a file outside the
  source tree through a parent directory swapped for a symlink
- Keep the guarded module_dir strip for daemon filter merge files
  (CVE-2026-53786) and the dir_flist check for the first incremental
  file list (CVE-2026-70459)
- Fix a one-byte heap read before the implied-include pattern for a
  source argument that ends in a slash
- Build without <linux/openat2.h>, which this platform's kernel-headers
  do not provide
- Keep the bounded hash_search() collision walk (CVE-2026-119741) and the
  aligned_i bound for --inplace
- Refuse a symlinked --link-dest/--compare-dest/--copy-dest basis on a
  pulling client, allow --read-batch from a FIFO, and let a non-root
  receiver enter a search-only destination directory
- Fix rrsync regressions in the CVE-2026-53783 fix: listing the
  restricted root as /, pushing onto an existing file, and a
  --delay-updates --partial-dir push
